# Colour-vision separation report

Perceptual distance between semantic colors, as simulated for each 
dichromacy. A just-noticeable difference is about 0.02.

Every pair of semantic families, not only the ones the build gates 
on. The gate is curated; this is the whole surface, so a collision 
that is awkward rather than dangerous stays findable.

These numbers are deliberately published rather than reduced to a 
verdict. Ten semantic colors cannot be made mutually distinguishable 
under all three dichromacies by colour alone — the palette maximises 
the separation available and the remainder has to come from an icon, 
a label, or shape.
